title: mw.notify.push-token.v1
description: A push device token the app registered for its wallet's bound device (ticket 110, FRS EXT-04): mw-app-gateway publishes it for PUT /app/v1/notifications/push-token, mw-notify (the consumer, so the owner, as with mw.notify.request.v1) keeps it in notify.push_device. One wallet has one bound device, so a registration replaces the wallet's other devices; a registration older than the stored one is ignored. Key: walletId. Consumers ignore unknown fields; only additive changes within v1.

walletId.description: The core's wallet id (the MSISDN for app wallets), from the caller's token.

deviceId.description: The bound device the request came from (X-Device-Id, checked by the device gate).

token.description: The FCM / APNs device token. Not personal data; logged masked to its last 6 characters.
